description: Set the loaf to the notch, left Gib where he was, and put one candle by the desk.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the loaf, entered the sixpence, and reminded him of the ruling she had already given.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Lay on the book and was left there.
name: Gib

description: Took the same threepence and said he does not know plays.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat three rows ahead in the Mayor's pew and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Preached Septuagesima, promised brevity, and turned the sand-glass a second time.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Accepted the penny, the sixpence and the threepence, and did not reopen the January verdict.
name: William Shakespeare
